abstract: This paper examines the impact of formal childcare use on maternal labor market outcomes. By combining Brazilian census data with administrative records on public childcare demand and supply in São Paulo, discontinuities in childcare shortages across birth cohorts and neighborhoods are exploited. This variation enables an identification strategy that compares observationally equivalent mothers within the same neighborhood who differ only in their likelihood of obtaining a public childcare slot. Among mothers induced into formal care by public provision, access to center-based care significantly increases employment, full-time work, and formal sector participation. The effects of formal childcare use on other household members, including partners and older children, are also examined, though the estimates are largely imprecise. Finally, a discrete choice model is estimated to evaluate counterfactual allocations of new public childcare centers. Policies targeting neighborhood income or excess demand yield similar gains in maternal employment and achieve roughly 60% of the employment effects of the optimal allocation.
title: Public childcare and maternal employment in Brazil

abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic induced dramatic changes in work arrangements, most notably through a sharp expansion of working from home (WFH). Starting in 2021, we fielded annual surveys on WFH in a nationally representative, probability-based panel. Using these data, we employ three complementary empirical strategies to estimate the impact of WFH on worker wellbeing. First, using discrete choice experiments, we elicit workers’ willingness to pay for additional days of WFH and show that remote work is a highly valued job amenity. Second, using pooled OLS and individual fixed-effects regressions, we document that workers who are allowed to work from home report significantly higher job satisfaction. Third, exploiting the pandemic-induced shift to WFH, we document that workers in jobs amenable to WFH at the onset of the pandemic experienced a relative increase in satisfaction compared to workers in non-amenable jobs; this effect persists and remains statistically significant several years after the pandemic’s onset. All three approaches consistently point to WFH as a valuable non-monetary job amenity. Because access to WFH expanded disproportionately across the socioeconomic distribution, the pandemic-induced shift toward remote work disproportionately benefited higher-socioeconomic-status workers.
title: The rise of work from home and its impact on job satisfaction

abstract: We study companies' decisions about holding annual shareholder meetings online during the Covid pandemic and returning to traditional in-person meetings post-pandemic. Among S&P 1500 companies, the frequency of virtual meetings shot up from less than 10% to more than 80% in the first year of the pandemic, with only gradual reversion to in-person meetings since then. In-person meetings are more likely for companies that have Republican majority boards and Republican CEOs, and for companies with headquarters located in jurisdictions that vote Republican. We find little evidence that Republican-led firms have unusually adverse experiences with virtual meetings, and we therefore conclude that their preference for in-person annual meetings aligns with conservative political opposition to other Covid-era regulations that restricted public gatherings and personal contact.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了新冠疫情期间公司决定在线举行年度股东大会，以及疫情后回归传统线下会议的现象。在标普1500指数公司中，虚拟会议的频率在疫情第一年从不足10%飙升至超过80%，此后仅逐步回归线下会议。线下会议更可能出现在董事会中共和党占多数、首席执行官为共和党人，以及总部位于投票支持共和党地区的公司。我们发现，几乎没有证据表明共和党领导的公司因虚拟会议而遭遇异常不利的经历，因此我们得出结论，他们偏好线下年度会议与保守派政治立场反对其他疫情期间限制公众集会和人际接触的规定相一致。
title: Republican boards' and CEOs' preferences for in-person AGMs
title_zh: 共和党董事会与CEO对线下股东大会的偏好

abstract: The municipal bond market has long been criticized for its lack of disclosure, which prior research often attributes to weak regulatory oversight. We offer another explanation: tax clienteles. Most municipal bonds are tax-exempt, and thus primarily attract high-tax retail investors, who may lack the incentive or ability to demand or monitor disclosures. In contrast, taxable bonds attract a broader investor base, including institutional investors who can demand disclosure. We find that issuers provide more continuing disclosures in years with taxable bonds outstanding relative to years without. Issuers also increase disclosures after issuing their first taxable bond and decrease disclosures after calling their last taxable bond. Exploiting a tax law change, we find that disclosures increase following plausibly exogenous increases in taxable bond issuances. Our results suggest that the tax clienteles for municipal bonds affect issuers’ disclosure practices and can inform those concerned with disclosure noncompliance in the municipal bond market.
abstract_zh: 市政债券市场长期以来因信息披露不足而备受批评，先前研究常将此归因于监管薄弱。我们提出另一种解释：税收客户群体。大多数市政债券免税，因此主要吸引高税率零售投资者，他们可能缺乏要求或监督披露的动机或能力。相比之下，应税债券吸引更广泛的投资者基础，包括能够要求披露的机构投资者。我们发现，发行人在有应税债券未偿还的年份相比没有的年份提供更多持续披露。发行人在首次发行应税债券后增加披露，并在赎回最后一笔应税债券后减少披露。利用一项税法变更，我们发现，在看似外生的应税债券发行增加之后，披露也随之增加。我们的结果表明，市政债券的税收客户群体影响发行人的披露实践，并可为关注市政债券市场披露不合规问题的人士提供参考。
title: The effects of tax clienteles on disclosure: Evidence from the municipal bond market
title_zh: 税收客户群体对信息披露的影响：来自市政债券市场的证据

title: The effects of immigration on agricultural development: Brazil in the Age of Mass Migration
title_zh: 移民对农业发展的影响：大规模移民时代的巴西

abstract: We study the interaction between firms, which can invest in green technologies, and a government, which can impose emission caps but has limited commitment power. Investment in green technologies generates innovation spillovers, reducing the cost of further investments. Spillovers generate intertemporal strategic complementarities between firms and government, and equilibrium multiplicity. In a “green equilibrium”, firms, anticipating caps, invest in green technologies, which reduces the cost of further investment, making the government willing to cap emissions. In a “brown equilibrium”, firms, anticipating no caps, don’t invest, so green technologies remain costly and the government gives up on emission caps. (JEL Q54, Q55, Q58, H23, O33)
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文研究企业（可投资于绿色技术）与政府（可设定排放上限但承诺能力有限）之间的互动。绿色技术投资产生创新溢出效应，降低后续投资成本。溢出效应引发企业与政府间的跨期战略互补性，导致多重均衡。在"绿色均衡"中，企业预期政府将设定排放上限而投资绿色技术，这降低了后续投资成本，促使政府愿意实施排放上限。在"棕色均衡"中，企业预期政府不会设定排放上限而不进行投资，导致绿色技术成本居高不下，政府放弃排放上限政策。（JEL分类号：Q54, Q55, Q58, H23, O33）
title: Emission Caps and Investment in Green Technologies
title_zh: 排放上限与绿色技术投资

abstract: In many expert–decision maker settings, information is richer than the language used to convey it. Motivated by this communication friction, we study Bayesian persuasion when the sender is constrained to use k messages. We show that the sender’s value is given by a k -point analogue of concavification, which we call k -concavification. An optimal information structure can be chosen with affinely independent posterior support, allowing the problem to be reduced to a lower-dimensional persuasion problem and then solved by standard concavification. We derive a tight bound on the value of communication capacity that applies to general persuasion games: the gain from a $$(k+1)$$ ( k + 1 ) st message is at most $$2/(k-1)$$ 2 / ( k - 1 ) times the value attainable with k messages. Finally, we solve a class of belief-threshold games in which the receiver chooses between a safe default and several risky actions, the sender gets zero from the default and the same positive payoff from any risky action, and a risky action is taken only when the corresponding posterior probability exceeds a threshold. We characterize the optimal coarse information structure, derive comparative statics in the prior and the threshold, and extend the analysis to heterogeneous thresholds and heterogeneous sender values across risky actions.
abstract_zh: 摘要 在许多专家与决策者互动的场景中，信息本身比用于传递信息的语言更为丰富。受这种沟通摩擦的启发，我们研究了当发送者被限制使用k条消息时的贝叶斯说服问题。我们证明，发送者的价值由凹化概念的k点对应物给出，我们称之为k-凹化。最优信息结构可以选择具有仿射独立后验支撑的形式，从而将问题简化为低维说服问题，并通过标准凹化方法求解。我们推导了适用于一般说服博弈的沟通容量价值的紧界：第(k+1)条消息带来的增益最多为k条消息可实现价值的2/(k-1)倍。最后，我们求解了一类信念阈值博弈，其中接收者在安全默认选项与多个风险行动之间进行选择，发送者从默认选项中获得零收益，从任何风险行动中获得相同的正收益，且仅当相应的后验概率超过阈值时才采取风险行动。我们刻画了最优粗糙信息结构，推导了关于先验和阈值的比较静态分析，并将分析扩展至风险行动具有异质性阈值和异质性发送者价值的情形。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Persuasion with Coarse Communication
title_zh: 粗沟通中的说服

abstract: Accurately estimating tail risk in financial markets is crucial yet difficult, especially when data are scarce. This paper investigates the use of Quantum Boltzmann Machines (QBMs), a class of quantum generative models capable of capturing complex, high-dimensional, and heavy-tailed distributions through quantum superposition and entanglement. Compared to classical Restricted Boltzmann Machines, QBMs offer greater expressive power and sampling efficiency. We apply this framework to assess risk for newly listed firms with limited historical data and find that QBM-augmented estimates significantly improve the prediction of long-term risk measures, including Value-at-Risk and expected shortfall, making QBMs a promising tool for financial modeling.
abstract_zh: 准确评估金融市场的尾部风险至关重要，但尤其在数据稀缺时颇具挑战。本文探讨了量子玻尔兹曼机（QBMs）的应用，这是一类能够通过量子叠加和纠缠捕捉复杂、高维及重尾分布的量子生成模型。与经典受限玻尔兹曼机相比，QBMs展现出更强的表达能力和采样效率。我们将此框架应用于评估历史数据有限的新上市公司的风险，并发现QBM增强的估计显著提升了对长期风险度量（包括风险价值与预期短缺）的预测能力，使QBMs成为金融建模中颇具前景的工具。
journal: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
source_issue: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control, Volume 190
title: Simulating Heavy-Tailed Economic Data with Quantum Boltzmann Machines: Applications to Downside Risk in Firms with Limited Histories
title_zh: 使用量子玻尔兹曼机模拟重尾经济数据：在有限历史企业下行风险中的应用

abstract: We investigate the influence of trading institutions on emotional arousal and bidding behavior through a series of behavioral and physiological experiments involving an investment task. In line with the competitive arousal hypothesis, we show that market institutions exacerbate the emotional arousal associated with winning bids, especially when buying an asset leads to substantial earnings. The market treatment exhibits stronger overbidding and bubble dynamics than baselines that use a Becker-DeGroot-Marschak mechanism. Treatment differences disappear for investors who exhibit no base rate emotional arousal. Our study shows that emotions are an important mechanism for understanding market outcomes and suggests designing new trading institutions to mitigate competitive arousal and subsequent overbidding in markets.
abstract_zh: 我们通过一系列涉及投资任务的行为与生理实验，探究了交易制度对情绪唤醒及竞价行为的影响。与竞争性唤醒假说一致，我们发现市场制度加剧了与中标相关的情绪唤醒，尤其是在购买资产能带来可观收益的情况下。相较于采用贝克尔-德格鲁特-马沙克机制的基线情境，市场处理表现出更强烈的过度竞价和泡沫动态。对于未表现出基础情绪唤醒的投资者，处理组间的差异消失。本研究显示，情绪是理解市场结果的重要机制，并建议设计新的交易制度以缓解市场中的竞争性唤醒及随之而来的过度竞价现象。
journal: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
source_issue: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
title: Trading Institutions, Emotional Arousal, and Overbidding
title_zh: 交易制度、情绪唤醒与过度出价

abstract: In McMahon et al. (2024) the authors demonstrated the effectiveness of a hybrid quantum solver in improving the liquidity efficiency of Canada’s high-value payments system (HVPS), altering the payment queue in order to minimize liquidity requirements. In this work, we apply a similar technique to the Italian segment of TARGET2, the Eurosystem’s HVPS, using the Constrained Quadratic Model (CQM) solver provided by D-Wave. This application achieves improvements in optimizing payment batches of size 70 and 140, showing daily average liquidity savings of respectively EUR 23 million and EUR 38 million over a 35 days sample. In addition we clarify the causes and possible extent of the liquidity savings realized. Introducing a machine learning framework to identify batch features that enhance liquidity savings, we find that batch optimizability increases with the number of participants acting as both senders and receivers, as well as the number of unique receivers within the batch. Finally we benchmark the CQM solver results against those obtained using a simulated annealing algorithm (SAA) under the same time constraints, finding comparable liquidity savings for batch sizes of 70 and 140 payments. The SAA is extended to handle batch sizes of up to 700 payments, a scale that is challenging for current quantum hardware, demonstrating a more than tenfold increase in liquidity savings.
abstract_zh: 在McMahon等人（2024）的研究中，作者展示了一种混合量子求解器在提升加拿大高价值支付系统（HVPS）流动性效率方面的有效性，通过调整支付队列以最小化流动性需求。本研究将类似技术应用于欧元系统HVPS的意大利部分——TARGET2，采用D-Wave提供的约束二次模型（CQM）求解器。该应用在优化规模为70和140的支付批次方面取得了改进，在35天的样本期内，日均流动性节省分别达到2300万欧元和3800万欧元。此外，我们阐明了所实现流动性节省的原因及可能范围。通过引入机器学习框架来识别增强流动性节省的批次特征，我们发现批次的优化潜力随着同时作为发送方和接收方的参与者数量以及批次内独特接收方数量的增加而增强。最后，我们将CQM求解器的结果与在相同时间约束下使用模拟退火算法（SAA）获得的结果进行基准比较，发现在70和140笔支付的批次规模下，两者实现了相当的流动性节省。SAA被扩展以处理高达700笔支付的批次规模，这一规模对当前量子硬件而言颇具挑战，展示了流动性节省超过十倍的提升。
journal: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
source_issue: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
title: Liquidity Optimization in Gross Settlement Systems with Quantum Reordering: Application to TARGET2
title_zh: 量子重排序下大额结算系统的流动性优化：在TARGET2中的应用

abstract: Using longitudinal Young Lives data from Andhra Pradesh and Telangana, India, we examine the effect of noncognitive skills on cognitive abilities at the onset of adolescence and later adolescence, and address endogeneity by using siblings’ noncognitive traits and primary caregiver well-being as imperfectly excluded instruments for the focal child’s noncognitive abilities. Our results suggest that agency improves mathematical ability at the onset of adolescence, indicating a sensitive period of development. No similar effect on language abilities at the same stage indicates domain-specificity of agency effects. Self-efficacy has no effect on cognitive outcomes at either stage. We are unable to reject the null that agency and self-efficacy have no effect on cognitive abilities in later adolescence. Agency effects are concentrated among boys, consistent with theories of gender-specific socialization.
abstract_zh: 利用印度安得拉邦和特伦甘纳邦的纵向青年数据，我们考察了非认知技能对青春期初期及后期认知能力的影响，并通过将兄弟姐妹的非认知特征及主要照料者福祉作为焦点儿童非认知能力的不完全排除工具变量来处理内生性问题。研究结果表明，自主性在青春期初期能提升数学能力，这表明存在一个敏感发展期。同一阶段未发现对语言能力有类似影响，说明自主性效应具有领域特异性。自我效能感在两个阶段均未对认知结果产生显著影响。我们无法拒绝自主性与自我效能感对青春期后期认知能力无影响的零假设。自主性效应集中于男孩群体，这与性别社会化理论一致。
title: Dynamic complementarity between noncognitive and cognitive skills: evidence from adolescent development in India
title_zh: 非认知技能与认知技能之间的动态互补性：来自印度青少年发展的证据

abstract: Fiscal sustainability, closely linked to government solvency, is essential for public financing and, consequently, for ensuring the normal functioning of economic activity. In the context of rising global debt levels and higher borrowing costs, as recently highlighted by the International Monetary Fund, this paper examines the sustainability of fiscal policy across the world economy using a combination of estimation methods and tests. Adopting an approach that integrates panel data with time-series analysis for a sample of 38 countries over the past half-century, the initial conclusion is that global fiscal policy has been sustainable. However, a country-by-country analysis reveals a more nuanced reality. According to the ranking proposed in this paper, slightly more than two-thirds of the countries can be classified as exhibiting either unsustainable fiscal policies (Level C) or partial sustainability with potential risks (Level B) over the 1974–2023 period. The remainder of the sample shows evidence of fiscal sustainability (Level A); however, even within this level, the strength of this relationship varies considerably across countries, highlighting substantial heterogeneity in fiscal sustainability. By providing a comprehensive cross-country assessment based on a relatively long time series using rigorous applied techniques, this paper offers timely and policy-relevant insights for both academics and policymakers.
abstract_zh: 财政可持续性与政府偿付能力密切相关，是公共融资的基础，进而保障经济活动的正常运转。在全球债务水平攀升、借贷成本上升的背景下（国际货币基金组织近期已强调此问题），本文综合运用多种估计方法与检验手段，考察全球经济体的财政政策可持续性。通过将面板数据与时间序列分析相结合，对过去半个世纪38个国家的样本进行研究，初步结论显示全球财政政策总体具有可持续性。然而，国别分析揭示了更为复杂的现实。根据本文提出的分级体系，在1974-2023年期间，略超三分之二的国家可归类为不可持续的财政政策（C级）或存在潜在风险的局部可持续性（B级）。其余样本国家呈现财政可持续性证据（A级），但即便在这一层级内，各国可持续性关系的强度也存在显著差异，凸显财政可持续性的高度异质性。本文基于较长时序数据，运用严谨的应用技术方法提供全面的跨国评估，为学术界和政策制定者提供了具有时效性和政策参考价值的洞见。
title: Fiscal sustainability in the world economy: evidence from panel and time-series analysis of 38 countries over half a century
title_zh: 世界经济中的财政可持续性：基于38个国家半个世纪面板与时间序列分析的证据

abstract: This paper examines whether standardized system specifications improve the fiscal efficiency of local governments. Although ICT has been widely promoted through e-government initiatives to improve government operations, the effectiveness of system standardization has received limited attention. We study Japan’s Regional Information Platform (RIP), a standardized system specification that facilitates interoperability across municipal administrative systems and weakens vendor lock-in. Building on a model of municipal procurement under switching costs, we show that standardization reduces expenditure through two channels: weakened vendor lock-in that lowers system costs, and improved cross-departmental interoperability that reduces labor input. Using variation in RIP adoption across Japanese municipalities, we estimate difference-in-differences models and find that RIP adoption substantially reduces per capita total expenditure. These findings suggest that e-government outcomes depend not only on ICT adoption itself but also on whether administrative systems are standardized and interoperable.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了标准化系统规范是否能够提升地方政府的财政效率。尽管信息通信技术（ICT）已通过电子政务倡议被广泛推广以改善政府运作，但系统标准化的有效性却鲜少受到关注。我们研究了日本的区域信息平台（RIP），这是一种标准化系统规范，旨在促进市政行政系统间的互操作性并削弱供应商锁定效应。基于一个考虑转换成本的市政采购模型，我们证明标准化通过两条渠道降低支出：一是削弱供应商锁定从而降低系统成本，二是改善跨部门互操作性从而减少劳动投入。利用日本各市町村RIP采纳情况的差异，我们估计了双重差分模型，发现RIP采纳显著降低了人均总支出。这些研究结果表明，电子政务的成效不仅取决于ICT采纳本身，还取决于行政系统是否标准化且具备互操作性。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Financial impacts of standardized system specifications: evidence from japanese municipalities
title_zh: 标准化系统规范对财政的影响：来自日本地方政府的证据

abstract: We propose and study a model of strategic network design and exploration where the hider, subject to a budget constraint restricting the number of links, chooses a network with a distinguished source node and the location of an object in the network, reachable from the source. Meanwhile, the seeker, not observing the network and the location of the object, chooses a network exploration strategy starting at a fixed node in the network. The network exploration follows the expanding search paradigm of Alpern and Lidbetter (2013). We obtain a Nash equilibrium and characterize equilibrium payoffs in the case of linking budget allowing for trees only. We also give an upper bound on the expected number of steps needed to find the hider for the case where the linking budget allows for at most one cycle in the network.
abstract_zh: 我们提出并研究了一个战略性网络设计与探索模型，其中隐藏者受限于链接数量的预算约束，选择一个具有特定源节点的网络以及网络中一个可从源节点到达的物体位置。与此同时，搜寻者未观察到网络和物体的位置，选择从网络中的固定节点开始的网络探索策略。网络探索遵循Alpern和Lidbetter（2013）的扩展搜索范式。在链接预算仅允许树形结构的情况下，我们获得了纳什均衡并刻画了均衡收益。对于链接预算允许网络中至多存在一个环的情况，我们还给出了找到隐藏者所需预期步骤数的上界。
title: Strategic hiding and exploration in networks
title_zh: 网络中的策略性隐藏与探索

abstract: People often deviate from Bayesian updating by processing information in an optimistic manner. In such optimistic information processing, people tend to selectively incorporate information that is favorable to them. Furthermore, it is known that such selective belief updating imposes psychological costs on them. In this paper, we model optimistic belief updating with psychological costs and provide axiomatic foundations for it. Our model includes Bayesian updating as a special case while allowing for a unified axiomatization of various forms of optimistic information processing by modifying certain axioms.
abstract_zh: 人们往往通过乐观的方式处理信息，从而偏离贝叶斯更新。在这种乐观的信息处理过程中，人们倾向于有选择地吸收对自己有利的信息。此外，已知这种选择性信念更新会给他们带来心理成本。在本文中，我们构建了带有心理成本的乐观信念更新模型，并为其提供了公理化基础。我们的模型将贝叶斯更新作为特例包含在内，同时通过修改某些公理，实现了对各种乐观信息处理形式的统一公理化。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Costly Bayesian optimism
title_zh: 昂贵的贝叶斯乐观主义

abstract: Many real-world negotiations are persistently delayed, yet imposing deadlines is costly because it induces inefficient separations. Do all deadlines in one-on-one market transactions need to be perfectly credible? To improve trade efficiency, I propose a mechanism that introduces an intermediate, imperfectly credible deadline to facilitate agreement. Using a canonical seller–buyer dynamic bargaining model with a credible deadline, I analytically characterize the optimal degree of credibility of such a deadline that maximizes trade efficiency, leading to early agreements without triggering separations. Under a non-zero risk of separation, the seller is tempted to discount the price to secure a payoff, while the buyer is more likely to accept at the intermediate deadline because pricing resembles ultimatum offers. A laboratory experiment provides direct evidence of the mechanism’s effects that extend beyond the theoretical benchmark.
abstract_zh: 许多现实世界中的谈判常常被持续拖延，然而设定截止日期成本高昂，因为它会导致效率低下的分离。一对一市场交易中的所有截止日期是否都必须完全可信？为了提升交易效率，我提出了一种机制，引入一个中间程度的、不完全可信的截止日期来促进协议达成。利用一个带有可信截止日期的经典卖方-买方动态讨价还价模型，我从分析上刻画了此类截止日期的最优可信度，以最大化交易效率，从而在不引发分离的情况下促成早期协议。在存在非零分离风险的情况下，卖方倾向于降低价格以确保收益，而买方则更可能在中间截止日期接受，因为定价类似于最后通牒式报价。一项实验室实验提供了该机制效果的直接证据，这些效果超出了理论基准的预期。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Deadline credibility and trade efficiency
title_zh: 截止日期可信度与贸易效率

abstract: We used a preregistered incentivized online experiment to examine whether unfair treatment increases dishonesty toward uninvolved third parties and whether observers anticipate such effects. Unfairly treated participants were not significantly more likely to lie for personal gain. In contrast, spectators were nearly twice as likely to bet that unfairly treated participants would lie and judged such lying as more morally acceptable following unfair treatment. These patterns provide preliminary evidence of a sizeable belief–behavior gap in expectations about how unfairness influences dishonesty.
abstract_zh: 我们通过一项预先注册的激励性在线实验，考察了不公平对待是否会增加对无关第三方的不诚实行为，以及观察者是否能预见到这种效应。遭受不公平对待的参与者并未显著更倾向于为个人利益而撒谎。相反，旁观者押注遭受不公平对待的参与者会撒谎的可能性几乎翻倍，并认为在不公平对待后此类撒谎行为在道德上更可接受。这些模式初步揭示了关于不公平如何影响不诚实行为的信念与行为之间存在显著差距的证据。
title: Mispredictions about dishonesty after unfair treatment
title_zh: 不公平对待后对不诚实行为的误判

title: Corrigendum to “Country-level cryptocurrency uncertainty and bank cost of capital” [Economics Letters, 256, October 2025, 112614]
title_zh: 更正：“国家层面加密货币不确定性与银行资本成本” [《经济学快报》，第256卷，2025年10月，112614]

abstract: Using a randomized controlled trial across 31 rural junior high schools in China, this study examines the spillover effects of providing free eyeglasses to myopic students on the visual health of their non-myopic peers. Within one school year, the intervention significantly reduced visual deterioration among non-myopic students by 0.48 lines and lowered new myopia incidence by 10 percentage points (a 24.3% decline), while also improving eye-use behaviors. These spillovers cannot be explained by conventional interaction-based or shared environmental mechanisms typically emphasized in non-infectious health interventions. Instead, they are more consistent with observational social learning: non-myopic students observe peers being diagnosed with myopia and required to wear eyeglasses, which increases their awareness of vision risks, updates their risk perceptions, and shapes their attitudes toward eyeglasses, thereby prompting protective behavioral changes. This mechanism extends positive spillover effects beyond context-specific interventions (e.g., infectious diseases) to a broader range of health interventions, and offers new insights into the prevention of non-infectious conditions such as myopia.
abstract_zh: 本研究基于中国31所农村初中的随机对照试验，考察了为近视学生免费配镜对其非近视同伴视觉健康产生的溢出效应。在一个学年内，该干预显著减缓了非近视学生视力下降0.48行，并将新发近视率降低了10个百分点（降幅达24.3%），同时改善了用眼行为。这些溢出效应无法用非传染性健康干预中通常强调的基于互动或共享环境的机制来解释。相反，它们更符合观察性社会学习：非近视学生观察到同伴被诊断为近视并需佩戴眼镜，这提高了他们对视力风险的认识，更新了风险感知，并塑造了对眼镜的态度，从而促使保护性行为改变。这一机制将积极溢出效应从特定情境干预（如传染病）扩展到更广泛的健康干预领域，并为近视等非传染性疾病的预防提供了新见解。

title: Reap more than sow: Experimental evidence of spillover effects from free eyeglass distribution among rural students in China
title_zh: 多收少种：中国农村学生免费眼镜发放溢出效应的实验证据

abstract: Drawing on U.S. global trade data from 2015 to 2023, this study empirically examines the impact of the “friend-shoring” policy on semiconductor supply chain dynamics. The analysis reveals that a one-standard-deviation improvement in bilateral political relations is associated with a 0.28 percentage point increase in the U.S. import share of semiconductors from politically aligned countries. Supply chain realignment shows considerable heterogeneity: trade in raw materials and finished components has shifted toward politically aligned partners, whereas manufacturing equipment shows weaker responsiveness due to efficiency considerations and supply-side constraints. The policy has introduced a “security premium” in import prices, especially for manufacturing equipment and imports from upper-middle-income politically aligned partners. Despite U.S. efforts to reduce dependence on China, products with high reliance on Chinese sources show no substantial disruption. Moreover, allied countries have not experienced a significant increase in their export shares to the U.S. market, while China’s semiconductor exports to U.S. allies have continued to expand. These findings indicate that the friend-shoring has led to only limited restructuring within semiconductor supply chains and has not materially altered existing dependency patterns.
abstract_zh: 基于2015至2023年美国全球贸易数据，本研究实证考察了“友岸外包”政策对半导体供应链动态的影响。分析显示，双边政治关系每提升一个标准差，美国从政治盟友国家进口半导体的份额将增加0.28个百分点。供应链重构呈现出显著的异质性：原材料和成品组件的贸易已转向政治盟友伙伴，而制造设备因效率考量及供给侧约束，其响应程度相对较弱。该政策在进口价格中引入了“安全溢价”，尤其体现在制造设备及来自中高收入政治盟友伙伴的进口上。尽管美国致力于减少对中国的依赖，但对华高度依赖的产品并未出现实质性中断。此外，盟友国家在美国市场的出口份额并未显著增长，而中国对美盟友的半导体出口则持续扩大。这些发现表明，友岸外包仅促成半导体供应链的有限重组，并未实质性改变现有的依赖格局。
china_relevance_reason: journal or topic scope is China economy
title: “Friend-shoring” and global supply chains: Empirical evidence from the semiconductor industry
title_zh: 友岸外包”与全球供应链：来自半导体行业的经验证据

abstract: This paper quantifies the impact of the Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership (RCEP) on global value chains (GVCs) and welfare. Using a multi-country, multi-sector general equilibrium model with global input-output linkages, we distinguish between tariffs on intermediate and final goods to capture the granular trade-cost dynamics of RCEP’s implementation. Our results show that RCEP significantly bolsters intra-regional trade and enhances complex GVC participation, although patterns of integration diverge: China and Australia expand primarily through forward linkages, while Japan, South Korea, and ASEAN members integrate more deeply through backward linkages. Welfare decomposition reveals that more than half of the total gains are driven by indirect channels, specifically intermediate-goods trade and sectoral linkages, rather than direct final-goods liberalization. Counterfactual simulations further demonstrate that RCEP serves as a critical strategic buffer against global trade disruptions. While the U.S.-China trade war and the emerging “Trump 2.0” reciprocal tariff regimes pose substantial risks, deeper regional integration and services liberalization can significantly mitigate these adverse welfare shocks. These findings underscore that RCEP functions as a strategic anchor for regional value chains, playing a pivotal role in bolstering supply-chain resilience against the structural shifts and heightened uncertainties of the global trade environment.
abstract_zh: 本文量化了《区域全面经济伙伴关系协定》（RCEP）对全球价值链（GVCs）及福利的影响。通过运用一个包含全球投入产出联系的多国、多部门一般均衡模型，我们区分了中间品与最终品的关税，以捕捉RCEP实施过程中细粒度的贸易成本动态。研究结果显示，RCEP显著促进了区域内贸易，并增强了复杂全球价值链的参与度，尽管一体化模式存在差异：中国和澳大利亚主要通过前向联系扩展，而日本、韩国及东盟成员国则通过后向联系实现更深入的一体化。福利分解表明，总收益中超过一半由间接渠道驱动，具体为中间品贸易和部门间联系，而非直接的最终品自由化。反事实模拟进一步证明，RCEP在应对全球贸易中断时充当关键的战略缓冲。尽管中美贸易战及新兴的“特朗普2.0”互惠关税体制构成重大风险，但更深层次的区域一体化与服务自由化能显著缓解这些不利的福利冲击。这些发现强调，RCEP作为区域价值链的战略锚点，在增强供应链韧性以应对全球贸易环境的结构性转变与不确定性加剧方面发挥着关键作用。
china_relevance_reason: journal or topic scope is China economy
title: The economic and welfare effects of RCEP: A global value chain perspective
title_zh: RCEP的经济与福利效应：基于全球价值链视角

abstract: Consider the transition out of a stagnant Malthusian system spearheaded by high-human-capital people. Individuals with a stronger preference for offspring quality may be the first to escape the Malthusian regime and adopt modern fertility behaviours (Galor and Moav 2002). To test this hypothesis, we examine the relationship between family size and human capital among academics in Northern Europe in the two centuries before the Industrial Revolution. We measure the human capital of academics using a novel approach based on their publications. We find that scholars with a higher number of publications than the median shifted from having more siblings to having fewer siblings in the first half of the 18th century. Estimating the parameters of an evolutionary growth model by indirect inference, we show how Malthusian constraints initially led the high human capital families to reproduce more, before being endogenously replaced by Beckerian constraints with a tradeoff between child quality and quantity. Our results support an extension of Galor and Moav’s (2002) approach, in which the decline of Malthusian constraints is linked to the accumulation of human capital during the 18th century.
abstract_zh: 摘要 考虑一个由高人力资本个体引领的、摆脱停滞马尔萨斯体系的转型过程。对后代质量有更强偏好的个体可能率先脱离马尔萨斯体制，并采纳现代生育行为（Galor and Moav 2002）。为检验这一假说，我们考察了工业革命前两个世纪北欧学者家庭规模与人力资本之间的关系。我们采用基于学者出版物的创新方法衡量其人力资本。研究发现，在18世纪上半叶，出版数量高于中位数的学者从拥有更多兄弟姐妹转变为拥有更少兄弟姐妹。通过间接推断法估计演化增长模型参数，我们展示了马尔萨斯约束最初如何导致高人力资本家庭生育更多子女，随后被内生的贝克尔约束（子女质量与数量权衡）所取代。我们的研究结果支持对Galor and Moav（2002）理论的拓展，即马尔萨斯约束的衰退与18世纪人力资本的积累密切相关。
title: The Emergence of the Child Quantity-Quality Tradeoff - insights from early modern academics
title_zh: 儿童数量与质量权衡的出现——来自近代早期学术界的洞见

abstract: We study the effects of immigration during the Age of Mass Migration (1855–1920) on Brazil’s agricultural development in 1920. Instrumenting for a municipality’s immigrant share using the interaction of aggregate immigrant inflows and the expansion of Brazil’s railway network, we find that a greater share of European immigrants in a municipality led to an increase in farm values. The bulk of the effect was the product of more intense cultivation of land. We also find that it is unlikely that immigration slowed Brazil’s structural transformation. Our results imply that immigration into an emerging agricultural economy can contribute substantially to agricultural development.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了大规模移民时期（1855-1920年）移民对巴西1920年农业发展的影响。利用总移民流入与巴西铁路网络扩张的交互作用作为市政区移民比例的工具变量，我们发现，市政区中欧洲移民比例的增加导致了农场价值的提升。这一效应主要源于土地更密集的耕作。同时，我们也不认为移民减缓了巴西的结构转型。我们的研究结果表明，移民进入一个新兴农业经济体，能显著促进其农业发展。
title: The effects of immigration on agricultural development
title_zh: 移民对农业发展的影响

abstract: A lack of longitudinal data has largely prevented the detection of chronic depression among refugees and its intergenerational associations. I link three years of parental depression measures to children’s socio-emotional development and school attendance for Syrian refugees in Jordan. First, chronic depression is common, with over a quarter of adults likely depressed in all three survey rounds. Second, the chronicity of likely parental depression is strongly associated with increasing risk of abnormal child socio-emotional development, and both likely depression and abnormal socio-emotional development are associated with lower school attendance. The results point to caregiver behavior and household tensions as a potential mechanism. Chronic depression among a broadly representative sample of refugees appears to be prevalent and related to urgent child development and human capital needs.
abstract_zh: 纵向数据的缺乏在很大程度上阻碍了对难民慢性抑郁症及其代际关联的检测。我将约旦叙利亚难民父母三年的抑郁测量数据与儿童的社会情感发展及入学情况相联系。首先，慢性抑郁症普遍存在，超过四分之一的成年人在全部三轮调查中可能均处于抑郁状态。其次，父母可能患有慢性抑郁症与儿童异常社会情感发展风险增加密切相关，而可能的抑郁状态及异常社会情感发展均与较低的入学率相关联。研究结果指出，照护者行为及家庭紧张关系可能是潜在的作用机制。在具有广泛代表性的难民样本中，慢性抑郁症似乎普遍存在，并与紧迫的儿童发展及人力资本需求相关。
title: Chronic depression, child development and human capital among the forcibly displaced: Evidence from Syrian refugees
title_zh: 被迫流离失所者中的慢性抑郁症、儿童发展与人力资本：来自叙利亚难民的证据

abstract: We examine the effects of mandatory board gender quotas on unregulated firms that are connected to regulated ones via interlocking directorates. After the introduction of quotas, connected firms significantly increase their share of female directors relative to similar unconnected firms. The spillover effects are substantial — at least as large as the direct effects on regulated firms, challenging previous claims that quotas have no broader impact on women in business. Our results suggest that quotas indirectly broaden the supply of candidates for connected firms, along dimensions that include, but are not limited to, gender.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了强制性董事会性别配额对通过连锁董事网络与受监管企业相关联的未受监管企业的影响。配额引入后，关联企业女性董事比例相较于类似的无关联企业显著提升。这种溢出效应显著——至少与对受监管企业的直接影响相当，这挑战了先前关于配额对商界女性无更广泛影响的观点。我们的结果表明，配额间接拓宽了关联企业候选人的供给范围，其维度包括但不限于性别。
title: Changing the board game: Horizontal spillovers of gender quotas
title_zh: 改变游戏规则：性别配额的横向溢出效应

abstract: The paper evaluates the impact of the reform of the judicial map on the functioning of Italian civil justice. Implemented between 2013 and 2014, the reform abolished all branch offices and merged several small first-instance courts, substantially increasing the size of judicial districts and the scale at which civil justice services are provided. According to our findings, the reform led to a reduction in the demand for justice, plausibly due to higher access costs associated with increased distances to the courts. This decline was particularly pronounced in case types characterized by greater claimant discretion and lower expected stakes. On the supply side, the reform increased the number of cases resolved and reduced their average duration. These improvements were more pronounced in initially less efficient courts and in more complex case types, which benefited the most from the increased scale and specialization.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了司法地图改革对意大利民事司法运行的影响。该改革于2013年至2014年间实施，废除了所有分支机构，并合并了若干小型初审法院，显著扩大了司法辖区的规模及民事司法服务的提供尺度。研究发现，改革导致了对司法需求的减少，这很可能是因为法院距离增加所带来的更高获取成本。这一下降在原告自由裁量权较大且预期标的额较低的案件类型中尤为明显。在供给方面，改革增加了已解决案件的数量，并缩短了其平均审理时长。这些改善在初始效率较低的法院及更为复杂的案件类型中更为显著，后者从规模扩大和专业化中获益最多。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 248
title: The effects of the reform of the judicial map on the functioning of civil justice
title_zh: 司法地图改革对民事司法运行的影响

abstract: Within narrowly defined industries, the most productive firms produce far more than the least productive from the same inputs, and this dispersion widens in downturns. We build a tractable representative-agent model in which financial frictions—adverse selection and moral hazard—make firms sort endogenously into lenders, strategic defaulters, and producers. As credit conditions vary, the resulting misallocation gives aggregate total factor productivity (TFP) an endogenous component that accounts for about 30 percent of the variance of TFP at business-cycle frequencies, a third of it from strategic default. We show that our tractable model can match key features of the observed distribution of productivity across firms and its co-movement with output growth and credit conditions in the data.
abstract_zh: 在狭义定义的行业中，最具生产力的企业使用相同投入的产出远高于最低生产力企业，且这种差距在经济下行期进一步扩大。我们构建了一个易于处理的代表性主体模型，其中金融摩擦——逆向选择与道德风险——使企业内生地分化为贷款方、策略性违约方与生产方。随着信贷条件变化，由此产生的资源错配使全要素生产率（TFP）具有内生性成分，该成分解释了商业周期频率下约30%的TFP波动，其中三分之一源于策略性违约。研究表明，我们的可处理模型能够匹配观测到的企业间生产率分布的关键特征，及其与产出增长和信贷条件在数据中的协同变动关系。
title: Cyclical Fluctuations, Financial Frictions, and Productivity Differences across Firms
title_zh: 周期性波动、金融摩擦与企业间生产率差异

abstract: Labor markets feature large heterogeneity in employment stability: some careers provide lifetime employment, while others involve frequent transitions in and out of work. While this heterogeneity shapes earnings dynamics and labor market risk, its implications for household saving behavior remain poorly understood. We document two new empirical facts. More stable careers (i) exhibit steeper life-cycle earnings growth and (ii) accumulate significantly more wealth per dollar of income, even within narrowly defined worker groups. To interpret these facts, we develop a life-cycle search-and-saving model with heterogeneous employment stability, job-to-job mobility, endogenous human capital accumulation, and incomplete markets. The model matches both life-cycle earnings and wealth dynamics across careers. Our central finding is that heterogeneity in employment stability reshapes the nature of saving. Stable careers generate sustained earnings growth with a focus on life-cycle saving, while unstable careers are characterized by precautionary, buffer-stock behavior that limits long-run wealth accumulation. Quantitatively, differential earnings growth accounts for about 60% of the wealth gap across careers. These microeconomic differences have important macroeconomic implications. We demonstrate that heterogeneity in employment stability amplifies wealth inequality and substantially increases the macroeconomic consumption response to unemployment shocks.
abstract_zh: 劳动力市场在就业稳定性方面存在显著异质性：部分职业提供终身雇佣保障，而另一些职业则频繁经历就业与失业的转换。尽管这种异质性塑造了收入动态与劳动力市场风险，但其对家庭储蓄行为的影响仍鲜有研究。我们揭示了两项新的实证事实：稳定性较高的职业（i）具有更陡峭的生命周期收入增长曲线，且（ii）即使在严格定义的工人群体内部，每单位收入积累的财富也显著更多。为解释这些事实，我们构建了一个包含异质性就业稳定性、岗位间流动、内生人力资本积累及不完全市场的生命周期搜寻-储蓄模型。该模型能够匹配不同职业的生命周期收入与财富动态。核心发现是：就业稳定性异质性重塑了储蓄的本质。稳定职业产生持续的收入增长，聚焦于生命周期储蓄；而不稳定职业则呈现预防性缓冲库存行为，限制了长期财富积累。量化分析表明，收入增长差异解释了约60%的职业间财富差距。这些微观差异具有重要的宏观经济含义：我们证明就业稳定性异质性会加剧财富不平等，并显著放大宏观经济对失业冲击的消费响应。
title: Employment Stability, Earnings Dynamics, and Life-Cycle Savings
title_zh: 就业稳定性、收入动态与生命周期储蓄

abstract: Between 1880 and 1920, more than 20 million immigrants settled in the United States. We study how this migration wave affected innovation and growth. Using a newly constructed dataset linking individual census records to historical immigration records and the universe of US patents, we highlight a new channel through which immigrants contributed to growth: they disproportionately settled in urban innovation hubs. To quantify the aggregate and regional effects of this mass migration episode, we develop a new spatial growth model in which skilled workers have a comparative advantage in innovation and sort endogenously across space. We find that international arrivals after 1880 raised US income per capita by 8.2\% by 1940. Removing the subsequent immigration restrictions of the 1920s would have raised income per capita by a further 1.7\% by 2000. Immigrants' skill composition and their concentration in urban hubs are key drivers of these effects.
abstract_zh: 1880年至1920年间，超过2000万移民定居美国。本研究考察了此次移民浪潮对创新与经济增长的影响。通过构建将个人人口普查记录、历史移民记录及美国全部专利数据相关联的新数据集，我们揭示了移民促进经济增长的新渠道：移民不成比例地聚集于城市创新中心。为量化此次大规模移民事件的总体与区域效应，我们构建了新型空间增长模型，其中技能型劳动者在创新领域具有比较优势，并在空间上实现内生性分类。研究发现，1880年后的国际移民使1940年美国人均收入提升8.2%。若取消1920年代后续实施的移民限制，2000年人均收入将额外增长1.7%。移民的技能构成及其在城市创新中心的集聚效应是这些影响的关键驱动因素。

abstract: This paper develops a stochastic multi-sector climate-economy model to study how temperature targets, endogenous carbon pricing, and long-run macroeconomic risk shape sectoral asset prices. The model combines a reduced-form integrated assessment block with Epstein-Zin asset pricing. Sectors differ in productivity, carbon intensity, abatement costs, pass-through, and exposure to physical damages. For each temperature target, the policymaker commits to a target-consistent emissions path, and the carbon tax is determined endogenously, date by date and state by state, to implement it. The analysis delivers three main insights. First, stringent temperature targets are dominated by transition costs, whereas looser targets imply weaker transition pressure but larger long-run physical damages. Second, carbon intensity alone does not determine expected returns: endogenous carbon pricing can make brown sectors partly hedge-like, while stringent targets can generate substantial downside risk for high emitters. Third, once transition-cost and damage-exposure shifters are stochastic, the model generates both low- and high-premium brown-sector outcomes. The sign of the brown premium depends on the cyclicality of transition costs, pass-through, and the stochastic discount factor. The framework therefore connects climate targets to the cross section of sectoral risk premia in a tractable, scenario-consistent way.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个随机多部门气候-经济模型，旨在研究温度目标、内生碳定价及长期宏观经济风险如何影响部门资产价格。该模型将简化形式的气候综合评估模块与Epstein-Zin资产定价框架相结合。不同部门在生产率、碳强度、减排成本、成本传导率及物理损害暴露度方面存在差异。针对每个温度目标，政策制定者承诺遵循与目标一致的排放路径，并通过逐期、逐状态内生确定的碳税来实现该路径。分析得出三个核心结论：第一，严格的温度目标以转型成本为主导，而宽松目标虽转型压力较小，但长期物理损害更大；第二，碳强度本身并非预期收益的决定因素：内生碳定价可能使高碳部门具备部分对冲属性，而严格目标则可能为高排放部门带来显著下行风险；第三，当转型成本与损害暴露度冲击因子具有随机性时，模型既能生成低碳溢价也能生成高碳溢价的高碳部门结果。碳溢价的符号取决于转型成本周期波动性、成本传导率及随机贴现因子的交互作用。该框架以可操作且情景一致的方式，将气候目标与部门风险溢价的截面差异联系起来。
title: Climate Targets and Sectoral Risk Premia
title_zh: 气候目标与行业风险溢价

abstract: This paper examines family firms’ response to monetary policy tightening. By using a panel of about 130,000 non-listed EMU firms over the period 2011–2021, we show that family firms are more resilient to monetary policy shocks. Compared to non-family firms, they react to interest rate hikes by reducing tangible investments to a lesser extent. Fully family-controlled firms suffer a lower reduction in revenue and reallocate their debt from short to long term liabilities. Our results provide evidence of the existence of a corporate-ownership transmission channel. The presence of family firms appears to be an additional source of heterogeneity in response to monetary policy.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了家族企业对货币政策紧缩的响应。利用2011至2021年间约13万家欧元区非上市企业的面板数据，我们发现家族企业对货币政策冲击更具韧性。与非家族企业相比，家族企业对利率上调的反应表现为有形投资减少幅度较小。完全由家族控制的企业收入下降幅度较低，并将债务从短期负债重新配置至长期负债。我们的研究结果为存在企业所有权传导渠道提供了证据。家族企业的存在似乎是货币政策响应异质性的又一来源。
title: Investment Dynamics and Monetary Policy Shocks: Evidence from EMU Family Firms
title_zh: 投资动态与货币政策冲击：来自欧洲货币联盟家族企业的证据

abstract: The increasing use of monitoring technologies raises important questions about their impact on regulatory strategies and enforcement outcomes. This paper studies the adoption of the Continuous Emission Monitoring System (CEMS), a real-time pollution tracking technology in China. Using firm-level data, we find that CEMS adoption reduces corporate sulfur dioxide (SO2) and nitrogen oxides (NOx) emissions by 16.8% and 15.8%, respectively. Mechanism analyses indicate that CEMS-generated exceedance signals increase the observability of violations and success rate of inspections. We find no evidence that CEMS adoption crowds out enforcement or increases emissions among nearby non-CEMS firms. These findings suggest that monitoring technologies can enhance regulatory precision, which is important for the extension of new monitoring technologies.
abstract_zh: 监测技术的日益普及引发了关于其对监管策略和执法效果影响的重要问题。本文研究了中国实时污染追踪技术——连续排放监测系统（CEMS）的采用情况。利用企业层面数据，我们发现CEMS的采用使企业二氧化硫（SO2）和氮氧化物（NOx）排放分别减少了16.8%和15.8%。机制分析表明，CEMS生成的超标信号提高了违规行为的可观测性和检查成功率。我们未发现CEMS采用会挤出执法或增加邻近非CEMS企业排放的证据。这些发现表明，监测技术能够增强监管精准性，这对于新监测技术的推广具有重要意义。

abstract: The sociological literature suggests that within diverse communities, individuals create externalities on members of other social groups when they express identity through the consumption of market goods. Positive identity expression externalities lead individuals to increase their exposure to out-group identity expression, while negative externalities lead them to reduce it. At the same time, to the extent that identity expression is tied to market consumption, fiscal policy can influence how much identity is expressed by affecting individuals’ disposable income. We develop a theoretical framework in which identity expression externalities are addressed through these two channels: individuals privately adjust their social contacts to manage exposure, while local governments can use taxation to influence the visibility of identity in shared spaces. We study how these mechanisms interact, and how policy depends on which social group the government prioritizes and whether individuals react favorably or unfavorably to out-group expression. We find that governments amplify the behavioral response to diversity by adjusting the intensity of identity signaling through tax policy. We also show that greater openness to diversity can reduce demand for taxation, leading to more visible identity expression but also more private avoidance. The framework can accommodate a range of political-economy, fiscal, and institutional extensions.
abstract_zh: 社会学文献表明，在多元化的社区中，个体通过消费市场商品来表达身份时，会对其他社会群体的成员产生外部性。积极的身份表达外部性促使个体增加对外群体身份表达的接触，而消极的外部性则促使他们减少这种接触。同时，由于身份表达与市场消费紧密相关，财政政策可以通过影响个体的可支配收入来调节身份表达的程度。我们构建了一个理论框架，其中身份表达外部性通过两条渠道得以解决：个体私下调整其社会交往以管理接触，而地方政府则可以利用税收来影响共享空间中身份的可见性。我们研究了这些机制如何相互作用，以及政策如何取决于政府优先考虑哪个社会群体，以及个体对外群体表达是持积极还是消极反应。我们发现，政府通过税收政策调整身份信号的强度，从而放大对多样性的行为反应。我们还表明，对多样性更大的开放性可能减少对税收的需求，导致身份表达更加可见，但同时也增加了私下的回避行为。该框架能够容纳一系列政治经济学、财政和制度方面的扩展。
title: Diversity taxes: Linking identity expression, social contact, and taxation
title_zh: 多样性税：身份表达、社会接触与税收的关联
